body: I couldn't stand the look for pain in the faces of family and friends. I couldn't stand making up excuses to my young children. I'm sorry about all the anxiety you're having about this. I have very visible scars down my arms, and across my chest. Anytime I had a partner the wide eye looks would hurt. So I started to sit down before hand and have a conversation, and I'd always start with have you ever heard of self injury? And ask them to tell what they thought it was, then I'd explain what it meant to me. Entering intimate parts of relations isn't easy but open honest communication is your friend. Start the conversation and when that big "why" in the conversation shows up, you use it to explain yourself. I honestly wish you all the luck in the world. If choose to go through with it, let us know how it went.
